coran.intro: Reading (qāʿida), memorisation (hifẓ) and Quran player. Riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim, exact Tanzil text.
coran.hifz_texte: Notebooks E1 (children) and N1 (adults): yearly plan, three tracks every day (new, recent, old), reviews at D+1, D+2, D+3, D+7, D+14, D+30, practice validation by a parent. The teacher remains the only judge; no ijāza.
coran.lecteur_1: choice of reciter (only recitations under written licence);
coran.lecteur_3: repeat a verse or a range N times, with a “my turn” pause;
coran.lecteur_5: download by surah to listen offline.
coran.lecteur_licence: No audio without a licence: the player will be ready and voices added once the rights are secured.
coran.qaida_texte: Series qc1 to qc3: syllables, reading rules and tajwid.
sciences.intro: Creed, fiqh (Mālikī school), life of the Prophet ﷺ, hadith and adab — the books of the Religion series.
sciences.re_texte: Levels re1 to re5: creed, sīra, prophets, fiqh, adab, supplications, hadith; practice log signed by a parent (never graded).
sciences.ra_texte: Level ra1 (ra2 to ra4 coming): texts of the Mālikī school, hadiths with their references, case studies.
sciences.fidelite: Everything shown comes from the books, exactly as written: the app adds no religious content.
ecriture.trace_texte: With a finger or a stylus: I trace over the dots, trace on the light letter, then write alone. The app checks the direction (right to left), the lane and the dots, and never gives a grade.
ecriture.en_attendant: Meanwhile, each lesson keeps its “My writing book” part: we write in the paper exercise book.
lectures.texte: 62 graded booklets (2 series): illustrated pages, foldable translation, “I understand”, “My words” and the “I read this book” stamp. Each booklet is offered after the lesson where the learner met its words.
